title: Windows and WSL
summary: The native Windows installer uses uv-managed Python 3.12+; macOS/Linux remain 3.11+. --wsl teaches the separate Ubuntu route. Status, path doctor and uninstall report persistent user PATH and retain uv-owned entries. Native Windows acceptance and support remain pending. The source POSIX launcher shim installer refuses on Windows and directs users to the public Windows installer. Native Windows onboarding advises installing Git for Windows on PATH and retrying from a new terminal when Git is missing. Shared platform owners handle process custody, links and file locks; POSIX uid access refuses explicitly on native Windows. Profiles use the reset-preserved identity store directly.
